guide: Same line-drawn guide with a green bow tie, on screen from frame 1 (no walk-in or wave). Points at whatever the narration names, shrugs or thinks when something cannot happen, gives a thumbs-up when the idea lands. Mouth follows narration loudness; eyes follow the pointing target.
motion_rules: Vertical 720x1280. Hook text from frame 1; something changes every 2-3 s. Every on-screen action is triggered by a spoken word (scene beats). Enzymes are rounded shapes behind the strands with their name inside: DNA polymerase green, primase brown, repair proteins purple. Close-ups magnify the diagram 1.75x and return. Orange rings highlight what is being named. Summary cards repeat the narration's claim, never add a new one. Captions: 1-3 words, large, spoken word highlighted. Keep the top 120 px, right 120 px and bottom 200 px clear for the app.
narration_style: Friendly, conversational, short sentences (under 12 words), middle-school reading level, about 150-170 words a minute. Say 5-prime and 3-prime. Synthetic narration is disclosed in the manifest.
